newsitem.title: UK: Cowie says looking at London routes.
newsitem.headline: Cowie says looking at London routes.

text.p: Bus operator Cowie Group Plc said on Thursday it was already addressing the issue of its large number of London tendered bus routes which it said appeared to be the major concern behind the referral of its offer for British Bus to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
In June, Cowie agreed to pay some 282 million stg for British Bus, which was the largest privately-owned bus operator in Britain.
But earlier on Thursday, the UK government referred the acquisition to the MMC saying it raises competition concerns in respect of bus services in London and parts of Surrey and Kent.
Cowie said in a statement that, with the addition of British Bus, it would hold just over 26 percent of London's tendered routes -- above the 25 percent which is the preferred maximum.
The company said it does not believe that the acquisition operates against the public interest.
